title: Yoda and His Clone Troopers
front_description: As clone troopers pour out of a landed gunship, Yoda appears at the door and issues instructions. "Around the survivors a perimeter create," he tells his brand new army. Taxed by their great arena battle but still ready for a fight, Jedi heroes dash to the gunships and scramble in. Windu hangs on tight as the craft he's boarded, firing all its weapons, rises out of the topmost rim of the arena.
back_description: A clone trooper maquette by Michael Murnane, its armor reminiscent of the original Stormtrooper outfits
